en.headline: Lan Kwai Fong launches three-Saturday Halloween monster parade nights
en.dek: The association expects visitor numbers to rise 10 to 20 per cent from last year’s 80,000 as themed decorations, face painting and DJ sets begin this Saturday.
body: The Lan Kwai Fong Association said Halloween celebrations will run from this Saturday until 31 October, with “Monster Parade Night” costume parties held on three consecutive Saturday evenings from 7pm to 11pm.

The district has already switched to Halloween-themed decorations. Each party night will include a face-painting area, resident DJs and an immersive street performance by a “monster corps” starting at 8pm. More than 20 participating outlets are offering drink and food promotions.

The association said about 80,000 people visited last year and expects a 10 to 20 per cent increase this year. The events form part of the Tourism Board’s city-wide “Hong Kong Halloween Month” programme.

zh.headline: 蘭桂坊周六起一連三個周六辦萬聖節怪物巡禮夜
zh.dek: 協會料人流按年增一至兩成，去年約8萬人次，本周六起有變裝派對、面部彩繪及DJ表演。
body: 蘭桂坊協會表示，萬聖節慶祝活動將由本周六起至10月31日舉行，並於17日、24日及31日三個星期六晚上7時至11時舉辦「怪物巡禮夜變裝派對」。
整個蘭桂坊已換上萬聖節主題布置。活動設有面部彩繪專區、DJ現場表演，晚上8時「怪獸軍團」進行沉浸式街頭巡遊。超過20間商戶推出餐飲優惠。
協會指去年約有8萬人次到訪，相信今年人流可增一至兩成。活動屬旅發局「香港萬聖月」一部分。
